rules: Existing pyproject import-linter inward layers, SDK adapter ownership and scripts/check_architecture.py effect contracts remain unchanged. Packaging owns interpreter constraints; runtime modules keep their interfaces.

modules.responsibility: Declare installable interpreter range, dependency requirements and analysis configuration.
modules.interface: Installers permit Python >=3.12,<3.14; mypy analyzes Python 3.12 and Ruff retains its existing conservative py310 lint baseline; public entrypoint and dependencies remain compatible.
modules.effects: No runtime effects added; uv owns lock resolution and installers own environment writes.

contracts.rules: Inner layers cannot depend on adapters, composition or public facades; SDK dependencies remain adapter-owned.
Source effect guard and negative fixtures reject inner external effects and forbidden dependency edges.

checks.command: uv run --frozen lint-imports; uv run --frozen python scripts/check_architecture.py; uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Existing production layers/effects and forbidden-edge regression fixtures pass.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --python 3.12 pytest -n 4; isolated Python 3.13 frozen pytest -n 4
checks.expectation: Offline tests pass on both supported minor versions; live tests remain excluded.

checks.command: uv lock --check; uv run --frozen ruff check .; uv run --frozen mypy .; uv build; isolated wheel installs
checks.expectation: Lock/static checks/build succeed; wheel runs on 3.12/3.13 and excludes 3.11/3.14.

checks.command: uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_docs.py -n 0; git diff --check
checks.expectation: Documentation signatures/local links and whitespace pass.

documentation: Update README, contributor and current agent/Spec Kit compatibility guidance; parent updates corp-skills/cveta2 usage prerequisites.

review.reconciliation: Inspected final seven maintained tracked paths and all feature artifacts, including added documents; no application/test/checker modules changed and no new locked dependency versions or sources introduced. Canonical root unrelated untracked skill links and bugs/ are excluded. Parent full offline suite and fresh independent review accepted Python/architecture scope; companion source validation passed with parent publication pending. Native semantic-release added only CHANGELOG.md and project/lock version updates; release diff inspected and refs verified. Documentation-only delivery closure records those results with no new runtime or executable-contract impact.
